children: Kuwait has raised the official selling price (OSP) for Kuwait Export Crude (KEC) to Asia in October to a discount of $2.75 a barrel to the average of Oman/Dubai quotes, a price document reviewed by Reuters showed on Tuesday.
The producer set the October Kuwait Super Light crude (KSLC) OSP to $2.75 a barrel below Oman/Dubai quotes.
